rules: Every module version change appends one bump {from, to, package, correction_ids, reason, requires_user_opt_in}; 'to' must be greater than 'from' and 'from' must equal the previous current_version (merge against the version current at merge time, C23).
current_version must equal the manifest version and the implementation class version (scripts/check_version_ledger.py, p0_gate quick).
requires_user_opt_in=true marks a method upgrade: saved Studies are classified method_upgrade_required and need explicit confirmation in the UI (Q13); code-only bumps are false.

bumps.reason: Decision A4 (both profiles, a universal exception to the Q1 freeze): thermal investment net revenue = market income - generated MWh x (generation + fuel + carbon + unit_time cost), read from the PSM's value.agent-cashflow/v1 extension; VRE and storage keep gross revenue as profit (bit-identical). A decidable thermal group without a running-cost row fails closed. Investment proposals and retirements of thermal owners change, so saved Studies need explicit confirmation (Q13).

Interface change (plan 4.6 S10, decision Q8): the created DynamicAnnualStorageCost exposes bid_basis, which the default PSM's market rule set owns (cycle_only in the corrected profile). The module's own default (thesis_dwell_linear) and its numbers are unchanged for every other caller; the user-formula module declares 1.0.0 explicitly.

Energy-balance observation of the default PSM (plan 4.4 S4-S6, decisions Q7, A2, Q12): per-asset storage energy audit, source-classified surplus routing, the market rule set's declared balance boundary with a compatibility adjustment capped at numerical noise, and A2 stress events recorded in the ledger. Dispatch, prices, state of charge, costs and investment paths are unchanged (doctoral trajectory bit-identical); only accounting-zone ledger tables and columns change, so this is a code-identity upgrade without user opt-in (Q13).

Default PSM clearing and storage dispatch corrections (plan 4.6 S4-S10, decisions Q8, A2, A8): the kernel runs one of two market rule sets derived from the methodology catalogue. The corrected profile clears with D1-surplus, the storage-after-generation merit key, the avoided-cost down-regulation stack, per-period storage netting, per-period storage fees, no VRE skim, cycle-only dynamic storage bids and uniform-price settlement, so its dispatch, prices, storage state and investment paths change (method upgrade). The doctoral profile keeps the 0.6.0-alpha.2 dispatch bit for bit; both profiles report the P5-06 physical operating cost.

Asset bus shares are solved by expand-solve-aggregate (one sub-resource per bus share; capacity, power, energy and SOC times share) instead of injecting the whole asset at the last mapped bus (P1-01). Single-bus inputs give numerically equal results (only signed zeros and an integer curtailment zero differ in serialization). Studies with split mappings change numerically, so per Q13 the upgrade is marked as needing explicit user confirmation (pending author ruling; M2-P0-8a review). Since the M2 integration merged X0 S11 the flag is enforced: a saved Study that selects this module is classified method_upgrade_required (Q13) and runs under 1.1.0 only after the user confirms its revision migration.

P5-15 disclosure (plan 4.6 S10): storage reports carry dwell_source = not_tracked_staged_single_pool and preflight warns (GF_STAGED_DWELL_NOT_TRACKED) when a dwell-based storage-cost module is selected. Dispatch, prices and costs are unchanged (report-only).

value-corrected only (doctoral unchanged, Q1): storage headroom from the post-charge leftover surplus the PSM publishes (P5-01), zero with a recorded reason for a partial-year chronology or a PSM without the trace, one shared power-battery pool instead of three copies of the cap (P5-02), no kernel global rebound. Storage investment opens in corrected Studies, so saved Studies need explicit confirmation (Q13).

Solver contract v4 (Q5): after the primary solve total load shedding is locked (fixed at zero when the primary sheds nothing), then only the bid-cost terms carry a coefficient-aware numerical lock; GBP 1 is only the acceptance ceiling. v3 used GBP 1 as the lock allowance, which later phases spent on spurious shedding and asset-ID shifts (P2-01). Equal-price pro-rata grouping no longer splits by resource class; a down bid's forced part (the asset's realised-availability shortfall, schedule minus available energy, split over its down bids and capped at their capacity) stays outside the group, so only free volume is shared pro rata (M2-P0-8a review M3, landed after golden revision 1). Formulation value.lossless-zonal-redispatch/v2.
